behavior: A development build shows a warning when `NavigationMenu.Viewport` mounts with no `NavigationMenu.Positioner` above it in a root that is not nested. Such a menu opens, and then Escape, a click outside and a second click on its trigger do not close it. The list and the trigger turn off these close actions while the menu is open and the root has no positioner. The warning names the parts that the viewport needs. It comes after the mount, so a server render gives no warning. A nested root can have a viewport with no positioner, and it gets no warning. Base UI has the same close rules and gives no warning.
